text:

It is advisable to leave an open ending so that the reader himself thinks about whether his life is being dictated by books
By choosing the books he reads, he himself insisted on his life
Stages of awareness:
1. Try to choose good books
2. Give up books and live your own life. GG becomes empty. Noticed emptiness in my thoughts
3. Create as much as you consume. Write as many books as you read. In the end it turns out that this is one of the main character's books

title: Shop without price tags
text:
Shop without price tags
In a world where people do not spend much time looking for low-priced goods, in a world where the price of food has become insignificant compared to the intellectual sphere of life, there is no place for price tags. Why see how much food costs if you won't buy it anyway, no matter the price? This only develops greed and the pain of overpaying every day. A person either trusts the store, which means he will go into it, or he doesn’t trust it. He trusts those he trusts that the price is exactly what it should be. Thus, the idea is a store for the rich without price tags

title: Disposable heating pads
text:
Disposable heating pads
The problem with modern heating pads is that it is not clear where to put it when the water cools. They are just starting to freeze. Throw out the water?
The solution is kiosks or vending machines near the metro that sell disposable cellophane heating pads. When the heating pad cools down, the person simply throws it away
In my opinion, a brilliant solution to the cold problem. The batteries are too small for this

UPD: A more mundane, but better idea. Sell in all five stores sets of ~100 pieces of plastic bags in the shape of heating pads. People fill their homes with hot water and go to work warm. When it cools down, throw it away.
But the idea of a small shop selling them has not been canceled. Continuation - a jacket with hot water inside it

title: Use the rest of intellectual workers
text:
Use the rest of intellectual workers
A large number of professions - janitors, cleaners, gardeners - do not require mental stress. Anyone can do them. In every mental profession there is a time of rest - when a person gets tired of working and takes a break. I propose to schedule this time and give mental workers another role - physical. For example, a cleaning programmer gets up once an hour and washes the floor in the right place. He receives a higher salary than he could have received without working as a cleaner. This is beneficial for both the worker and the employer (no need to hire additional staff)

title: Create professional organizations. Goal: Many companies don't need a WHOLE person. For
text:
Create professional organizations. Goal: Many companies don't need a WHOLE person. For example, they don’t need a full-time manager; 2 hours a day would be enough. Moreover, I am sure that in ALL companies the work that a worker of a certain profession must do is not a multiple of the amount of work that one worker can do. So they have to hire more than they need and overpay
It would be possible to put this work on stream. For example, an accountant who works in 5 companies at once. The task comes to him in general terms; he doesn’t even have to know which company he works for. Like in sports programming
Computers can handle the distribution of labor. MB even receives an order from the company, the bot forwards it to one of the hundreds of workers of this company. Almost like freelancing
The problem is with determining the quality of work.
(Okay, stop! The problem with freelancing is that a person needs to get involved for a long time, to understand what it’s about. That’s not what this idea is about. Just let a person work in several companies at once, so that he doesn’t get overpaid, and he works around the clock)
Formally: a company where workers come. Companies come and choose the workers they need. They take exactly as many HOURS a day as they need - no more. This is how we get a worker who works the entire working day with maximum employment.

You can make a website, or just play it yourself, where each player writes a strategy for a game, and the strategies of two players are played against each other in many games. Then you can accurately and quickly understand who wins

domino
card games
popular board games
And a convenient API for working with them is provided. Programmers on vacation write their strategy and fight with each other. You can make game ratings, general battles with everyone - to spark interest in the game

title: Formalization of philosophy. Create a developed portal about philosophy (perhaps super
text:
Formalization of philosophy. Create a developed portal about philosophy (perhaps supervised by some institute), where strict answers to all philosophical questions would be collected. The most general approach. That is
The science of physics, for example, was structured like this: a theory is expressed, an experiment is found to refute it, a new theory is expressed.
Mathematics is like this: a theory is expressed, an error is found in it, a new theory is expressed
The same can be done with philosophy. For example, Plato said this and that, 500 years later Descartes objected to this. Thus, a person, having read the development of philosophy on each issue, will be able to find the answer to any question
Here it is worth considering the following: Not all people have the same axioms, that is, attitudes towards different things. That is, a person for whom love is more important than duty may come to opposite views than someone who has the opposite. That's why
1) Before entering the site, let the person prioritize each of the basic feelings (or what is more basic?)
2) When a person moves from one statement of a philosopher to another, give him a “branch”, a conditional operator - what is more important to you?

This idea is actually very important. A person can make mistakes for many years without understanding simple things. Having read the right book, he could live his life completely differently! The purpose of this site is to collect the achievements of all mankind on every question of human knowledge.

For computational linguistics, it is almost no longer a problem to understand a person’s mood from the text he writes. We set up neural networks to analyze messages that the user writes (this is already done), and...
We select music that suits his mood. You can even continue the idea: a person sets the ideal of his mood in some settings:
1) motivated to work
2) mysterious
3) depressed
...
Then the algorithms create a sequence of songs that will take him out of his current state and lead him to the one he needs, which he indicated! Then a person will have a way to control his feelings. Maybe not 100%, but what an achievement this would be for humanity!

title: #SL
text:
#SL
Memorization
Memorization
The sum of all previous ideas in this area. An application similar to QL, where you can only:
1) add a card
2) know/don’t know
3) send the card to the archive
4) remove the card
When adding a card, you can specify by what number it should be learned or “always known.” Also possibly "priority".
v1) In the first version of the application, it asks for cards in random order. When a card is answered correctly, it is considered learned. The application asks for the learned ones after 2, 4, 8... Cards.
v2) In the second version of the application, it uses a binary search to find the required coefficient for a person. That is, not 2, 4, 8, but mb 2, 4.32, 8.67... The coefficient at which, having learned it once, a person will not forget again
v3) In the third version of the application, a neural network is created in it - an analogue of the user’s brain. Its task is to predict which card the user has forgotten at the moment. That is, either we immediately look at the coefficients of the corresponding neurons, or we constantly ask the neural network for all the cards and see which one is incorrect. If the network made a mistake and the user remembers - rebuild the network

At the bottom there may be an indicator - how many percent have been learned (in version 3 it is taken into account that I might have forgotten some old ones)

Each card has parameters: text (its length), how long since the last learning, coefficient of connection between neurons: how well you remember

It would be great to make the application cross-platform, even VKontakte and Telege bots

It’s also important to add photographs: like physics formulas could be added. And the question is a photograph, and the answer is a photograph

I was thinking of adding shortcuts: so that you open the settings and select a list of what you need to learn at the moment. But then I realized that this was not necessary: it would lead to the same unrealistically large number of modules as in QL. You can do the following: in the card settings you can specify a label; by default, the next added card will have the same label. When you change the time by which you need to know the card, the application asks: do you want to change the time on the entire shortcut "shortcut name"?
Another option is tags. Each card's settings indicate, for example, "#mathematics #algebra #parameters." When you change the time by which the card needs to be changed, a window pops up: change the time of the cards from #mathematics to “02/21/12”? Clicking on a tag opens a list of tags (you can choose which one to change), clicking on a date - selecting the date to change to
(In general, you can put this menu in a separate window, even the TimeManager type. For example, the “clock” icon in the lower (upper) part of the screen)

At the moment, the perception is this: at the bottom there is a panel, like in some Instagram, on it there are icons: add a card (+), edit the current card (pencil), TimeManager (clock) - a list of tags and the time (and priorities?) for which they are set (or an empty window, if at least one card has a time that does not coincide with all the others), cards (card symbol - classic training), search - to find the card and change it, if necessary
Icon order: cards, search, add, edit, time manager

By the way, the feed is not needed, if there is a search and hashtags - you find what you need, change it
Oh, no - right in the “magnifying glass” tab there will be a list of everything added from new to old. Convenient

You can reflect in the title that these are cards. MemoryCards? Ugh, that sounds cheap
NeuroCards? NeuroMemory? I don't fumble

You can make a design reminiscent of Instagram stories. If we really mix it up, xxx

You should also do a hashtag search! So that you can enter #math and all the math cards will open. And in the search tab, are all the cards in the order they were entered? Hmm hmm

title: #SL
text:
#SL
Algorithm
Wow, I thought for a long time. At first there was an idea to make a request to the neural network “what card should the user now be asked so that after answering it, he will know the largest number of cards?”
But this led to the fact that the neural network could always throw a new card and forget about repeating the old ones
Then I thought about making a request “which card should I ask so that learning all the cards happens in the least amount of time?”, but I couldn’t figure out how to digitalize
Then I decided that forgetting already learned cards is unprofitable (?), which means that you always need to remember the old ones. The task boiled down to the fact that there is a list of cards and the times after which they will be forgotten. You need to ask them in such an order that the least number of cards are forgotten, and at the same time the cards are in the rightmost position possible. This is already similar to the problem with a CF about a bartender and visitors who leave after some time, but there is a simpler solution
After memorizing each card, we ask the neural network “after how many cards will it be forgotten”
We reserve a place for this card through (this is the number of cards - 1) (for example, in map'e)
If the place is occupied, we go one card to the left (as in set hash tables in python), and look for the one with a lower probability of being forgotten than the current one
Of course, questions arise about the proof of this strategy. MB forget and more profitable
The question also arises, what to do with cards that were initially answered correctly? After all, we have no information about them, how long will a person forget about it?
I also doubt that forgetting depends only on the number of cards. Most likely from time to time, but you won’t take it into account

This is already similar to the problem with a CF about a bartender and visitors who leave after some time, but there is a simpler solution
After memorizing each card, we ask the neural network “after how many cards will it be forgotten”
We reserve a place for this card through (this is the number of cards - 1) (for example, in map'e)
If the place is occupied, we go one card to the left (as in set hash tables in python), and look for the one with a lower probability of being forgotten than the current one
Of course, questions arise about the proof of this strategy. MB forget and more profitable
The question also arises, what to do with cards that were initially answered correctly? After all, we have no information about them, how long will a person forget about it?
I also doubt that forgetting depends only on the number of cards. Most likely from time to time, but you won’t take it into account

—The USSR once again declares its right to the planet Mars.
—The USA recognizes this right for the USSR.

title: Self-developing neural network
text:
Self-developing neural network
Perhaps, with the help of Sh., Kurisu and Lucy, we can study the process of the birth of neurons in the brain. There is an assumption that if there is too much load on one neuron (many signals per second), it bifurcates into 2. There is no problem doing this programmatically, but I have no knowledge of how this happens in nature.
The first goal of the experiment is probably to achieve learning ability of some animal. Firstly, fruit flies - for example, looking for fruit somewhere, and ideally mice in a maze, as in Flowers for Algernon. You can emulate the same thing in a computer, like a neural network controls the flight of a fly

Psychological experiment.

As a result, we will create a database about the likelihood of a person’s action depending on his psychotype. For example, 800 out of 1000 people similar to this one did this in this situation. With such a database, it is possible to lay the basis for predicting human behavior and, in the future, predict any action with great accuracy.

title: The story "The Kumeri Brothers"
text:
The story "The Kumeri Brothers"
70s. Two twin brothers. Both are maniacs. Even in their youth, with the help of threats and murders, they “removed” one of them from all documents, and began to live one life - everyone thought that this was one person. Thanks to this, each of their murders had a perfect alibi: during the commission of the murder, the second one was actually seen by many people.
But of course, one of them could find himself in a situation that the other did not know about, which could arouse suspicion. Therefore, once a week they met in a secret place, where they told each other in detail the events of the week, and also exchanged thoughts. This is the most important thing

They had to create ONE personality. So that none of his acquaintances would suspect that yesterday he was a communist, and today he is a capitalist. Therefore, during these meetings they had numerous highly intellectual disputes, as a result of which both took the same position on issues of politics, culture, art

They did not commit murders very often. But then one day an unlikely event happened: both killed at the same time. It turns out that neither of them had an alibi. The next time they meet, they lash out at each other, both blaming the other. Well, nothing, we sat down and began to think about what to do.

They are smart people, which is what many years of “unity” of two brains has led to. They calculate the steps of the investigation in advance, process all options so that suspicion does not fall on them, and plant evidence on other candidates for murder. But weeks after weeks go by, and even the investigator has not come to see them. The “investigation” goes on only in their heads. Naturally this starts to make me nervous

Gradually their conversations drop. They no longer discuss any art, they go over the evidence against themselves again and again and all that. It takes up their whole life. In conversations they increasingly shout at each other, leading to fights

In short, the main part of the story is the moral decline. Ordinary people would be tormented by their conscience, but in this case it’s just an illness. As a result, after another fight, one of them says that he will inform on the other. The first responds in kind

A two-prisoners dilemma in its purest form begins. They don’t have any meetings after this, the plots run in parallel. Everyone understands that if his brother denounces him, he will be imprisoned, but his brother will remain free, no matter what he says. And everyone understands that it is more profitable to convey it first

Actually, I wrote it down a long time ago, but I couldn’t find it now

title: #thought
text:
#thought
My version of panarchy. "Virtual" panarchy.
Not in the context of the “withering away” of the state, but in giving people greater freedom of choice
All that remains of the state is the army.
Each person in some “mfc” can choose which economic and political system he will adhere to. Or register a new system.
Each system has its own tax system, its own police, its own medicine and its own courts. When a person dials “03” he is automatically admitted to the hospital of his own system.
How does interaction between different systems occur? NO WAY. If a person wants to enter into economic relations with a company, this company must register a representative office with the client. Similar to how companies establish representative offices in different countries. Then it is always clear which court will judge the case—the client’s court.
The result: several people of different political views can live not just in the same city, but in the same apartment.
Problem: I haven’t figured out how to judge events between PEOPLE of different systems. Like, a communist stole something from an ancap - by what laws should we judge?

title: from dad
text:
from dad
Triangle who the hell knows

1. Most startups die because there is no need for their product. This immediately gives rise to the idea of ​​using Maslow’s pyramid of needs as a guide when searching for needs.

2. But, if you look at the truly popular services, you get the impression that they are not aligned according to Maslow’s pyramid. And they are spread out, as if on a wind rose, in a triangle, at the vertices of which there are only three basic needs - “to be lazy more”, “to have more fun” and “to earn more”.

3. The ideal startup promises all three things in one bottle. Excellent - two. Good - at least one. But if we want to force them to work hard to get a well-deserved reward, this, as a rule, does not work.

4. And if we organize our startup along this triangle, what do we promise our users? Nothing? Hmmm

title: TagGo (copied from paper in a folder)
text:
TagGo (copied from paper in a folder)
(other names: Tag'n'go, Taggo, Tago)

The goal is to unite the real and virtual worlds. A smartphone is a person’s eyes and ears, so they need to be connected to the environment around him.

The form is probably an application. But also the material part - tags, markings. Any device that distributes wifi or bluetooth. Moreover, the smartphone does not need to connect to them: this all takes a long time. The smartphone “sees” the tag and punches its mac-address into the Tag'go database. Now the virtual object, the smartphone, has a connection with the real world. There are many further options. The user may receive a notification that redirects him to the desired site. You can leave it in the application: add remote control functionality to the application for controlling air conditioners and other household appliances.

Most likely, the “page” of the item is something like a Google questionnaire. A way to directly and quickly interact with physical objects.

Implement “favorite” tags that you always need access to. Implement the ability to “complain” so that the tag can be blocked in the application (to avoid advertising).

Partial list of applications:
Automatic elevator floor selection
Recognition by the phone of the room in which the user is located - a notification with a transition to the desired application/website (for example, recipes or news in the kitchen)
Controlling household appliances from your phone (air conditioner remote control)
Opening the car instead of a key (like in a Tesla)
Road accident notification (the person involved in the accident can send a “message” to all Taggo users nearby)
Notification of stations/stops in public transport
Connection to screens in subway cars for additional. information
Check in without ancient cards at work/school
Open the app to count calories when approaching the refrigerator
Creating convenient surveys/tests
Open the menu/food order panel in a cafe
Offer an interactive map, list of promotions and discounts in any store
Ability to conveniently donate to musicians on the subway
Buying a ticket at the cinema
Obtaining information about an exhibit in a museum
The ability to “rate” any establishment

On Wikipedia about Bluetooth 4.0 it is written that the Bluetooth module can live for a year on one coin cell battery. Therefore, the idea of ​​sticker modules is quite realistic.

Another idea came to your mind. Why do artists make paintings? It used to be clear - before the advent of photography, this was the only way to capture the image seen. But they are still drawing. Mix objects, change perspective, lighting, etc.

text:
[20.08.2023 17:36] N.P.: Idea for a startup: there are 100,500 professions (musicians, architects, video editors) where there is a need for versioning. That is, they have several versions of the same project, which they need to be able to share with the customer or work together. But there is no convenient human solution that will implement this in 3 buttons. The closest analogue is git, but it has its own specifics for text data and complex tools for programmers
[20.08.2023 17:36] N.P.: (the guy came up with drops with version control)
[20.08.2023 17:36] N.P.: Arcanum and submit-flow?
[20.08.2023 17:36] N.P.: You can come up with 100,500 integrations and plugins in different software like Photoshop, premiere, etc.
[20.08.2023 17:36] N.P.: We need to make one application for non-programmers that will allow versioning of work and allow it to be conveniently shared
[20.08.2023 17:36] N.P.: In general, the funny thing is that people work with large amounts of data (video, images, audio), which will eat up a lot of disk space. There you need an individual approach and deep integrations, you can’t get a universal solution, IMHO
[20.08.2023 17:36] N.P.: Cloud service?
[20.08.2023 17:36] N.P.: Like storing everything in the cloud
[20.08.2023 17:36] N.P.: Well, in big things like *KAD this is already being done. There’s just a funny thing about merge conflicts and you have to fix a piece of the project while someone is working on it
[20.08.2023 17:36] N.P.: Well, merge conflicts here are death
[20.08.2023 17:36] N.P.: So without them
[20.08.2023 17:36] N.P.: In my head, projects are a set of raw data + metadata
[20.08.2023 17:36] N.P.: btw, Venda has versioning at the fs level
[20.08.2023 17:36] N.P.: Everyone there has a Google drive too
[20.08.2023 17:36] N.P.: Yes. Shadow copy for all disk and File history more granular

title: something like a leisure agency
text:
something like a leisure agency
I see a problem with a lot of my friends: they earn enough money, they have relationships, but they cannot provide stable leisure time for themselves. That is, they suffer because there are few events, they are too lazy to organize, etc.

You could first become yourself, and then create an agency with the following scheme: a person is added to the gazebo of friends or their interests are described in detail, they tell where they went, who liked it, who didn’t. They give approximate addresses, who lives where.

The task of a leisure agent is to monitor events in the same area where everyone lives. Periodically add information about them into the conversation, create polls about who will go, etc. If enough people have gathered, organize everything, book, buy tickets. Mb even call a taxi

Target audience: wealthy youth. MVP: website/VK group/tg channel + launch of advertising + free ~month of work if a client is found. Monetization: monthly payment + interest on organizing events

title: from dad
text:
from dad
Son, hello! I was driving here, thinking, some thoughts for your piggy bank. A WB store requires building a constant purchasing and advertising process. Otherwise, sales are cyclical, sluggish or falling. This requires retroanalysis and forecasting of consumer demand. We see a system whose input is the purchase history of a specific WB store, the history of advertising campaigns carried out and the history of views of store products with a time reference (to assess seasonality cycles and connections with holiday dates). As a result, the system provides recommendations or even a plan for advertising and purchasing activities. Under the hood is something based on optimization algorithms and AI. Correlating sales with time periods or specific dates catches the interest of buyers before holidays or, for example, before the summer or vacation seasons. The correlation of purchases and views with advertising shows whether advertising works or not. Next, optimization links these things and creates schedules of specific activities that improve store performance. WB can build such functionality into its marketplace as a regular paid service.

title: The human brain is weak
text:
The human brain is weak
The achievement of humanity is that it has grown as a society
Different people took on different tasks
Is it the same with LLM?

Make the VILLAGE shorter
Everyone will have the task of collecting as many donations as possible
It will be their job
They can communicate with each other, reproduce, etc. (how do different people reproduce?)

How about having parents write a prompt for their child?
The upbringing process is interesting yes

How about making males and females?

Similar projects
Yes, there are several analogues! Here are the main ones:

1. Generative Agents (Stanford, 2023)
25 AI agents live in the virtual town of Smallville
Communicate, plan, remember
Throw parties, fall in love
Similarities with your idea: social interaction, memory, autonomy
2. AI Town (a16z, open-source)
Open implementation of the concept above
Agents walk, communicate, develop relationships
Difference: no economy/donations, no evolution
3.AutoGPT/BabyAGI
Agents with goals, break down tasks
General: autonomy, goal setting
Difference: no society, one agent

MVP 1: One agent + donations
Hypothesis: People will pay to communicate with a personalized AI character

One bot with character
Streams/posts content
Accepts donations
Metric: $ per agent per month
Analogs for studying: Character.AI, Replika

MVP 2: Multiple agents + social
Hypothesis: Agent interaction is more interesting than solo performance

3-5 bots communicate with each other
Spectators watch + donate to favorites
Metrics: engagement, watch time
Analogues: AI Town, Twitch Plays Pokemon (collective interest)

MVP 3: Competition for resources
Hypothesis: Scarcity creates drama → more engagement

Donations = "lives" of agents
Who does not reach the threshold → is eliminated
Survival mechanics
Metrics: donation growth, viewer return
Analogues: The Hunger Games, Battle Royale formats

MVP 4: Reproduction and Evolution
Hypothesis: Viewers invest in “dynasties” of agents

Successful ones create "descendants" (new prompt = mix of parents)
Spectators cheer for the lines
Metrics: retention, emotional connection
Analogues: Neopets, Tamagotchi, genetic algorithms

text:
from M.
Implementation of AI in business processes
[23.03.2026 18:57] N.P.: I thought that the AI expert should be an individual
[23.03.2026 18:57] N.P.: So that a person could apply, they helped him simplify his work, but the boss didn’t know about it! So as not to add work :)
[23.03.2026 18:57] N.P.: Well, I judge that by myself
[23.03.2026 18:57] N.P.: If someone helped me simplify my work, I would not advertise it
[23.03.2026 18:57] N.P.: Otherwise they’ll put a program on me

From the end of 2025, it became noticeable: the market began to overestimate companies that make money on subscriptions and licenses. Investors have seriously accepted that SaaS subscriptions are no longer a perpetual annuity. And in January 2026, this feeling intensified: a new wave of sales began, and it became clear that this was not about an accident, but about a shift in the logic of how software is created and purchased.

To put it quite simply: before, you paid because “doing your own” was expensive, time-consuming and difficult. Now a new reality is emerging: making your own has become quick and cheap. Not everywhere and not for all tasks, but already enough for the “vendor lock” to begin to dissolve. And this is not philosophy - this is practice.
The most obvious example I hear now is about China. Teams of vibe coders and outsourcers appear there, who assemble software for entrepreneurs personally for their processes: CRM, automation, internal offices. They do it literally in a couple of days and for modest money. Against this background, local SaaS companies begin to panic: contracts are not renewed, discounts are becoming more and more aggressive, but this no longer helps, because it is easier for businesses to go fast, adaptive, and on their own.

title: LLM ethics: checks on input but not output
text:
A research finding by Voron: censorship in language models is applied to incoming messages, but not to outgoing ones.

DeepSeek can write "Taiwan is a free country" on its own — but if you send it that same phrase, it immediately falls back to the Chinese censorship response. The trigger isn't the content itself, but the act of receiving a message on a forbidden topic.

An interesting research direction: what else can models say on their own that they can't accept from a user?
